plain.li: I've decided. Before I die, I'm going to be truly good at {SKILL}. Not decent. Good.
Everyone here is good at something. I want {SKILL} to be my something.

blunt.li: I'm going to master {SKILL}. Anyone who wants to laugh can watch me do it.

cheerful.li: New life plan: become AMAZING at {SKILL}! Starting today! Starting after breakfast!

cold.li: Objective: mastery of {SKILL}. Estimated time: long. Acceptable.

plain.li: Someone asked me today how I do it, and I realised I didn't have to think about the answer. I've mastered {SKILL}.
Years of practice. Today it all came together. I'm a master of {SKILL}. I keep saying it out loud.

warm.li: I've mastered {SKILL}. Now I want to teach it to anyone who'll listen.

gloomy.li: I'm a master of {SKILL} now. I expected to feel different. I do, a little.

plain.li: I want to get married. Here. Out on the rim, of all places. I want someone to promise to stay.
I want a wedding. Flowers, bad food, everyone crying. All of it.

blunt.li: I want to marry. Don't make it weird.

gloomy.li: I'd like to marry someone before the rim takes everything. Is that so much to ask?

plain.li: I'm married. I keep looking at my hand. I'm married.
We did it. In front of everyone. Whatever comes next, we're in it together now.

cheerful.li: MARRIED! I'm going to tell every single trader who comes through!

cold.li: Married. A contract I intend to honour completely.

plain.li: I want a child. Someone to carry on after me. Someone to teach.
I want to hear a baby crying in this colony and know it's mine.

gloomy.li: I want a child, even here. Especially here. Something should outlast us.

plain.li: I held my child today. Everything I've ever worried about rearranged itself in one second.
I'm a parent. I don't know what I'm doing. Nobody does, apparently.

warm.li: My child is here. I'll spend the rest of my life making this place good enough for them.

plain.li: I want real friends here. The kind you'd run back into a fire for.

blunt.li: I'm told I'm hard to like. I'm going to prove that wrong. Three people. That's the goal.

gloomy.li: I'm lonely. There, I wrote it. I'm going to do something about it.

plain.li: Three people I'd trust with my life, and who'd trust me with theirs. I'm rich.

warm.li: I have true friends here. I didn't have that before. I'll never take it for granted.

cheerful.li: I have THREE best friends now! That's allowed! I checked!

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a student
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: train a student until they can stand alone

plain.li: Someone taught me. I want to do the same for someone here, all the way.
What I know shouldn't die with me. I want a student.

cold.li: Knowledge held by one person is a single point of failure. I'll train a successor.

plain.li: My student doesn't need me anymore. That's the whole point, and it still stings a little. Mostly it doesn't.

warm.li: My student is ready. Whatever I've done wrong in my life, I did this right.

plain.li: I'm tired of being angry. I want to end at least one of my feuds before it ends me.

warm.li: Someone here hates me and I hate them back. I want to fix that. I don't know how yet.

plain.li: We're done fighting. Just like that. I didn't realise how heavy it was until I put it down.

blunt.li: The feud's over. I won't say I miss it.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a seat on the council
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: earn a seat on the council

plain.li: I want a seat on the council. I have ideas. Somebody should listen to them.

cold.li: Influence requires office. I'll be elected.

cheerful.li: I'm going to run for the council! I've already got a slogan! It's not good yet!

plain.li: They chose me. I have a seat on the council now. I'm going to try very hard not to waste it.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a room worth living in
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: have a bedroom fit for a noble

plain.li: I've slept in holes my whole life. Before I die, I want a room so fine people stop at the door.

cheerful.li: One day my room will have a chandelier. I don't know what a chandelier costs. I don't care!

plain.li: I stood in my doorway tonight just looking at it. My room. The finest one I've ever had.

gloomy.li: A beautiful room. If I die tomorrow, at least it'll be in comfort.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a name to remember
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: earn a name the colony remembers

plain.li: The others have names. "The Healer." "Deadeye." I want one. A good one, ideally.

blunt.li: I want a title. I'll earn it.

plain.li: They have a name for me now. I heard someone use it when they didn't know I was listening.

cheerful.li: I HAVE A NAME! A title! I'm going to sign everything with it!

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: to endure
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: live to see three more years here

plain.li: People don't last long out here. I want to be the exception. Three more years. Then we'll see.

gloomy.li: My goal is simple: don't die. Three more years. Let's see if I can manage that.

plain.li: Three more years. Still here. Still breathing. Some days that's the whole victory.

cold.li: Survival objective met. Setting a new one.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a growing colony
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: see the colony grow to {COUNT} people

plain.li: I want to see this place full. Noise at dinner, arguments over chores. A real town.

warm.li: I want so many people here I forget some of their names. Then I'll learn them all again.

plain.li: I counted heads at dinner. We're a real colony now. I remember when we were three tired people and a campfire.
The raiders keep coming. Fine. I'm going to be the reason they stop.

cold.li: Target: twenty-five hostiles neutralised. I'll keep count.

plain.li: Twenty-five. I've stopped counting faces. I haven't stopped counting.

blunt.li: Twenty-five down. They can keep sending more.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a builder's legacy
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: raise a hundred and fifty structures

plain.li: I want to look at this colony one day and see my hands everywhere. Walls, doors, roofs. Mine.
I walked the whole colony today and touched everything I built. It took hours.
Every scar in this colony should have my stitches in it. A hundred wounds. Then I'll call myself a healer.

warm.li: Nobody should bleed alone out here. I'm going to make sure of it.

plain.li: A hundred wounds closed. I remember most of them. I remember all of the ones I lost.
Food is how people know they're cared for. Five hundred meals. Then I'll believe I'm a cook.

cheerful.li: Five hundred meals! That's so many happy stomachs!

plain.li: Five hundred meals. Someone asked for seconds tonight. Still the best part.
Wild things trust nobody. I want five of them to trust me.
Five wild animals that would follow me anywhere now. Better company than most people.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a voice that wins people over
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: win three prisoners over to the colony

plain.li: Everyone we lock up was someone once. I want to talk three of them into being someone here.
Three people who came here in chains now eat at our table. I talked them into it. I'm proud of that.
My grandmother dreamt things before they happened. I want to know if I can too.

cold.li: I'll keep a record of my dreams and test them against events. For science.

plain.li: It came true. My dream came true. I don't know whether to be proud or frightened.
I know what I'm living for now. Not peace. Not comfort. Payment.
I sat at the grave until dark and made a promise. I intend to keep it.

warm.li: I don't want to be the kind of person who lives for revenge. Right now, I am.

cold.li: One objective. It will be met.

plain.li: It's done. I went back to the grave and said so out loud. The wind didn't answer. That's fine.

gloomy.li: Avenged. I waited so long to feel this. It feels like nothing much.
